feed.title: NPR Topics: Business
feed.subtitle: Reporting on the money that flows through our economy, from Wall Street financial firms to Silicon Valley tech giants, small businesses, consumers, employers and workers. Plus podcast episodes of Planet Money and The Indicator.

entry.title: With days to go before the midterms, data shows the U.S. economy is doing well
entry.summary: GDP grew at an annual rate of 3.4% in the third quarter in the last major read on the economy ahead of the midterm elections — but many Americans continue to struggle with affordability.

entry.title: Tariffs, diesel and computer chips are driving up costs for automakers
entry.summary: American auto companies say they are paying more for key components like computer chips, steel and copper — plus the fuel needed to transport their products.

entry.title: Business as a liberal art? Some high schools say yes
entry.summary: Learning about money is becoming a growing part of the high school curriculum.

entry.title: Fed holds interest rates steady even as inflation remains stubborn
entry.summary: The Federal Reserve opted to leave its benchmark interest rate unchanged — but investors widely expect the central bank to raise rates at its next meeting in December to combat stubborn inflation.

entry.title: Dolores Huerta, influential labor leader, feminist and civil rights icon, dies at 96
entry.summary: Huerta co-founded the United Farm Workers union to improve working conditions in the nation's fruit and vegetable fields and coined the phrase "Sí, se puede!" that became a widespread rallying cry.

entry.title: How a lifelong Republican came to lead the data center battle in Ohio
entry.summary: In Ohio, many people are displeased with the state's rapid buildout of data centers. It's a hot issue in the midterms, as political candidates from both parties try to ease voter concerns.

entry.title: After a year of uncertainty, Job Corps is making a comeback
entry.summary: Last year, President Trump ordered more than 100 Job Corps training programs to close to save federal funds. A lawsuit stopped that, and now enrollment is up for "AI-proof" trade career training.

entry.title: How Aldi is pushing down grocery prices
entry.summary: The German-owned chain's low prices are winning over shoppers — and pushing competitors to respond.

entry.title: Polymarket has investigated 'dozens' of election-related cases
entry.summary: The prediction market has hired a former FBI official to make sure political insiders don't use the platform for profit from confidential election information.

entry.title: AI giant Anthropic files for an IPO that could break records
entry.summary: The AI company, which makes the popular Claude chatbot, has filed for an initial public offering that could be one of the biggest ever.
